question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**by**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the usage of the following:
 
 
• **" By" is used to indicate the means or method of doing something.**

 
 
• Example: I travel to work by car.
 
 
 
• "With" is used to indicate the instrument or tool used to do something.
 
 
• Example: I cut the vegetables with a knife.
 
 
 
• "Off" is used to indicate separation or disconnection.
 
 
• Example: Turn off the lights when you leave the room.
 
 
 
• "On" is used to indicate activation or connection.
 
 
• Example: Turn on the TV to watch your favorite show.
 
 
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the action of playing is being done by the musical instruments.
 
• Thus, the correct word to use in the blank is "by."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
